landing.heroDescription: NeoCAST supports various input tools including Neo Smartpen, stylus, touch, and mouse. A real-time collaboration platform where you can freely write, draw, and communicate anytime, anywhere.
landing.section1Description: Teachers (hosts) can monitor all students' (guests') handwriting at a glance and provide individual feedback. Connect as vividly as if you were in the classroom, regardless of physical distance.
landing.section2Description: Write on paper with Neo Smartpen and see it appear on screen instantly. Mouse and touch input are also fully supported. Use your most comfortable tool to unleash creativity.
landing.section3Description: Record and replay not just the final result, but the entire thought process. Share and deeply analyse problem-solving steps or design sketch flows.
landing.section4Description: Invite participants easily with just one link, like Zoom, Teams, or Meet. Join sessions instantly by clicking the link, without complex installation or registration.
landing.section5Description: Your valuable ideas and data are protected safely. Manage session access with strong security technology and keep your personal information safe.

newConcept.subtitle: smart classroom with Ncode
newConcept.description: Transform ordinary PDFs into smart Ncode textbooks and record students' thinking processes in real-time. Analyse and evaluate learning processes with AI and provide personalised feedback for each student.

ncode.title: Ncode Technology
ncode.description: Microscopic patterns printed on paper, nearly invisible to the eye, but the core technology that enables smartpens to accurately recognise position, pen pressure, and time information.

smartpen.title: Smartpen Technology
smartpen.description: Provides the same writing feel as a regular pen, with built-in high-speed camera and processor tracking coordinates up to 240 times per second and transmitting data.

paperhub.title: PaperHub Technology
paperhub.description: Safely stores and manages all data generated on physical paper in digital space, allowing access and search anytime, anywhere.

pod.title: Print On Demand
pod.description: An eco-friendly solution where anyone with a regular laser printer can print and use Ncode-embedded textbooks or forms without a dedicated factory.

footer.description: Since our founding in 2009, we have been researching technology that breaks down the boundaries between paper and digital. NeoLAB boasts the world's No.1 market share and technology in smartpen and Ncode technology.
